$comment: R468 (2026-11-03): timing.startAfter=push starts review at push once every prerequisite registers on the head; timing.cancelOnCiRed=true voids reviews on healable red CI. Rollback: set timing.startAfter to fast-checks or ci-green. timing.startEarly (off|shadow|on, default shadow; WE_REVIEW_START_EARLY) resolves standard → platform review → tool timing → environment with policy-cascade source logging. off preserves the review-start gate; shadow refuses pending/missing CI but logs a would-start note; on allows review and red-team dispatch early on the pinned head only when CI has registered at least one readable row on that head, every prerequisite has a present row on the pinned head that is queued, in_progress, pending, waiting, or completed success, and no healable CI is red. Missing prerequisites refuse with ci-not-registered and their names; an unknown prerequisite set refuses with unknown-required-set. Push uses the repo fast checks, falling back to its required set; ci-green uses the required set. Pending is the only relaxation of the strict gate. Empty or absent CI evidence refuses without a shadow note. When startEarly is on or startAfter is push, accepted verdict publication waits for strictly green required CI on the reviewed head, independently of cancelOnCiRed. timing.startEarlyPublishWaitMs (nonnegative safe integer, default 1500000; WE_REVIEW_START_EARLY_PUBLISH_WAIT_MS) bounds that wait; timing.startEarlyPollMs (positive safe integer, default 30000; WE_REVIEW_START_EARLY_POLL_MS) sets its interval. Both resolve standard → platform review → tool timing → environment with source logging. Each poll rechecks the head; red CI holds publication for the CI-heal path, and timeout or unreadable evidence holds publication for a later retry. This grants no ready-to-merge or merge permission: those retain their strict green-CI gates. The existing scripts/settings/review-concurrency.json maxLiveReviewRounds cap also bounds early reviews; no separate cap. Legacy scripts/review-settings.json timing leaves remain supported, with this timing block taking precedence. postAcceptAdvisory.mode (off|shadow|on, default shadow; WE_REVIEW_POST_ACCEPT_ADVISORY_MODE) resolves standard → platform → tool → environment with source logging; on remains shadow in this slice. Platform preference for the review operation's seats (see scripts/lib/review-seat-settings.mjs). parallelSeats on|off: every juror seat of a review-pr run starts at once instead of one after another (tool override env WE_REVIEW_PARALLEL_SEATS). seatsByTouchSet on|off: the review daemon picks the seat list from the PR's touch-set before the run starts, so an all-prose PR (e.g. backlog cards only) does not seat the security juror; code PRs keep both mandatory seats (tool override env WE_REVIEW_SEATS_BY_TOUCH_SET). speculativeRedTeam on|off (scripts/lib/review-speculative-red-team.mjs): the review job starts the post-accept red team beside the juror seats and keeps it only on accept; deliberately NOT set here, so the platform preference (review.speculativeRedTeam in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json) or the standard default (on) applies; set it here only to override for this repo (env WE_REVIEW_SPECULATIVE_RED_TEAM beats both). shadowSeats.antigravity.model names the agy model for the SHADOW mandatory seats only (advisory, never counted; trial of Gemini 4 Argon from 2026-10-13); absent = the routing policy's model; on an Argon failure the seat re-runs loudly on the routing policy's model; env WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_MODEL beats it. shadowSeats.antigravity.trialReviews is the trial length in completed shadow reviews (one review-pr run where that model returned a usable answer), not days (operator 2026-10-13); the report node scripts/lib/agy-shadow-trial-report.mjs shows N of that count and says trial complete when reached; reaching it never promotes anything (env WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_TRIAL_REVIEWS beats it). unattendedAcceptRequiresCleanReferrals (boolean, default true; env WE_REVIEW_UNATTENDED_ACCEPT_REQUIRES_CLEAN_REFERRALS) allows accept or prevention-outstanding after filing, with no open mandatory referrals on the live head; prevention-outstanding also requires every broken finding to be ruled card or not-real; changes is accepted only through the round-cards rule (cards 5471/5470), after its card is filed, under the same live-head and live-referral gate; resolves standard → platform review → this tool file → env, logging through policy-cascade. carryAcrossRebase on|off carries a trusted verdict across identical whitespace-sensitive net patches through the sanctioned restamp writer (WE_REVIEW_CARRY_ACROSS_REBASE). humanSurfaceUsesNetDiff (boolean, standard true): human-surface-repark judges the pinned head against its merge-base with freshly fetched origin/main; unavailable net basis skips a complete clean GitHub files list, otherwise re-parks fail closed with a fixed public reason. Raw git diagnostics stay in local logs. Set false only to restore the GitHub files-list decision. Platform review.humanSurfaceUsesNetDiff is inherited unless overridden here; env WE_REVIEW_HUMAN_SURFACE_USES_NET_DIFF beats both. Operator 2026-10-16: shadowSeats.antigravity.enabled defaults false (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_ENABLED). When enabled with scope sampled, sampleRate defaults 0.1 (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_SAMPLE_RATE), deterministic SHA-256 of repo#pr; allowed 0 <= rate < 1, 1 is refused with a logged warning. Off shows agy shadow off (setting), never a quota hold. minNonClaudeSeats defaults 1 (WE_REVIEW_MIN_NON_CLAUDE_SEATS), a positive integer: add Codex advisory seats to meet it and report any unavailable/failed-seat shortfall in the write-up. scope defaults high-care: elevated/high earned shape or existing sensitive escalation reasons; sampled restores sampleRate (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_SCOPE). dailyCap defaults 100 seat attempts per America/New_York day (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_DAILY_CAP); atomic reservations beside the agreement log count starts, including retries. Cap skips and quota holds never retry on the routing model. These leaves resolve standard → platform → tool → env with source logging. autoRoundGrant.cardOnly (scripts/conveyor/auto-round-grant.mjs; operator 2026-10-19 standing ruling, confirmed 2026-10-20 "automate, capped at 3 per PR"): enabled true|false turns on the automatic +1 review round for a PR whose net diff vs main is only backlog/** at its round cap (standard off); it also needs the operator's recorded standing ruling (an open issue the operator authored, scripts/conveyor/standing-ruling-mark.mjs), whose bounds always win; maxPerPr can only lower the per-PR cap (standard 3, never above 3 or the ruling's); repos lists the owner/repo slugs it applies to (standard web-everything/web-everything). reviewChurn (scripts/conveyor/review-churn.mjs; R365 fix 4, 2026-11-01): sameTree off|shadow records (never enforces) a head whose git tree equals an already accepted reviewed head's; capMode off|shadow|on + maxLoopsPerPr raise a needs-you note after that many reviews of distinct heads (the review still runs); shadow records churnShadow on the dispatch row and changes nothing; env WE_REVIEW_CHURN_SAME_TREE / WE_REVIEW_CHURN_CAP_MODE / WE_REVIEW_CHURN_MAX_LOOPS beat it.
